notes: Kiribati is the one nation genuinely split between this sphere and S3 (Polynesia) in real ethnography — the Gilbert Islands (the bulk of the country, and its namesake) are Micronesian; the Phoenix and Line Islands (much smaller population, but a large share of the country's land/sea area) are Polynesian-influenced. Drawn here as the country's dominant identity, per the whole-first-order-subdivision-equivalent logic this project uses elsewhere, not because the mix isn't real.
